Bill.BriefDescription: Suspending the interstate compact for adult offender supervision.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the interstate compact for adult offendersupervision; adding a new section to chapter 9.94A RCW; providing aneffective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.94A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Effective June 1, 2010, Washington state is temporarilysuspending the state's future participation in the interstate compactfor adult offender supervision, for any new offenders requesting to berelocated to Washington, until such time action is taken and complianceis made by the compact as a whole and by individual states to comply,equity is made in the equal exchange of offenders by other states, pastaction and behavior of other states that send offenders to the state ofWashington is reviewed, and negotiations and an active role is made bythe compact and the interstate commission to assure that the compactoperates to protect the safety of the people and communities ofWashington and other individual states. (2) The state of Washington shall continue to meet its obligationunder RCW 9.95.270 and 9.94A.745 to other states for the supervision of p. 1 HB 2624those parolees, probationers, and other offenders that have beenapproved to reside in the state of Washington under the interstatecompact on or before June 1, 2010. (3) During the legislative session of 2011, the legislature shallreview the statute, rules, and regulations relating to the interstatecompact for adult offender supervision to determine whether the stateof Washington shall renew its participation in the interstate compactfor adult offender supervision or suspend its participationindefinitely.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJune 1, 2010.
